id.description: A unique identifier for the poll.

meetingId.description: A unique identifier for the [meeting instance](/docs/meetings#meeting-series-scheduled-meetings-and-meeting-instances) to which the poll belongs.

startTime.description: The date and time the poll started in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) compliant format.

endTime.description: The date and time the poll ended in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) compliant format.

timerDuration.description: The length of time in the alarm box, in seconds.

displayName.description: The name of the poll coordinator.

email.description: The email of the poll coordinator.

personId.description: The ID of the polling coordinator.
